title: Satori business app registry entry
description: Has the package's component contribute its app to the app registry: the <app> element, from agentic-ui-config/app.json, naming every file of the app definition the registry serves. Writes it when there is none, and otherwise brings its files in step with the package's.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.
